invalidationReason: Phase 9G-B.0 READY_FOR_PHASE_9G_B_BLIND_ENTRY status was premature and unaccepted by independent audit because the pairwise matrix contained synthetic placeholder differences and artificial confidence intervals, candidate registry contained mutated profile/config identifiers, and cache provenance was built in-memory rather than verified from frozen source records.

identifiedB0Defects.description: B.0 Check 5 generated synthetic meanDifference=0.0 and identical artificial confidence intervals [-0.008, -0.001] across unrelated candidate pairs instead of reproducing them from authenticated scenario-level differences.
identifiedB0Defects.resolution: B.0.1 replaces synthetic pairwise generator with exact scenario-level records from A.3.2 bakeoff, preserving authenticated bootstrap CIs and requiring explicit INSUFFICIENT_REPRODUCIBLE_PAIRED_EVIDENCE where source run vectors are absent.

identifiedB0Defects.description: B.0 mutated Robust ByteDance profile ID with an unapproved prefix and recorded divergent configuration SHAs for Transkun, Aria, and RTT.
identifiedB0Defects.resolution: B.0.1 assembles registry directly from validated frozen A.2.5 and A.3.2 source records, restoring exact profile ID CALIBRATED_CONTEXT_1820-onset-0.30-frame-0.05 and exact configuration SHAs.

identifiedB0Defects.description: B.0 Check 7 created cache provenance statements in memory rather than binding to verified disk evidence.
identifiedB0Defects.resolution: B.0.1 validates provenance against A.24 raw manifest and A.3.2 raw evidence verification receipt, strictly enforcing that self-computed digests cannot claim MATCHED_TRUSTED_BASELINE.

identifiedB0Defects.description: B.0 pairwise matrix included only 2 metrics, silently dropping 6 frozen product safety metrics and timing median/P95.
identifiedB0Defects.resolution: B.0.1 restores all 8 frozen product safety metrics, explicitly marking unavailable timing vectors as NOT_EVALUATED and non-comparable offline latency as LATENCY_NOT_COMPARABLE.
